Christmas in the Wakefield District

Get ready for lots of festive fun this winter. Visit the Wakefield district for Christmas markets, family activities, entertainment and seasonal treats.

New Traders Christmas Market

New and first-time traders will be selling their products at Castleford Indoor Market. Find unique gifts, handmade items and tasty festive treats. You can also browse the great range of products from our regular market traders. Come along, support local businesses and shop local this Christmas.

Date: Saturday 21 November

Time: 9am to 3pm

Location: Castleford Indoor Market

Find out more at www.wakefield.gov.uk/new-traders

Elf School

Elf School is coming to Castleford and Pontefract. Join Santa's helpers and make your own elf passport, name badge and reindeer food. All materials are provided. Just bring your Christmas spirit.

Drop in anytime between 10am and 3pm to take part.

Dates

  • Saturday 28 November, Castleford

  • Saturday 5 December, Castleford

  • Saturday 12 December, Castleford

  • Saturday 19 December, Pontefract

Time: 10am - 3pm

A Castleford Christmas

Castleford will be full of Christmas cheer with three days of free family fun. Enjoy entertainment, festive shopping and seasonal activities in the town centre.

Dates: 5, 12 and 19 December

Time: 10am - 4.30pm

Saturday 5 December

  • Street entertainers

  • Bath bomb workshop

  • Arriva festive bus experience

Saturday 12 December

  • Christmas market with local traders and small businesses

  • Street entertainers

  • Festive DJ

  • Giant walk-in snow globe

  • Christmas grotto photo opportunity

  • Free donkey rides

  • Performance by Castleford Male Voice Choir

  • Children's fairground rides

Saturday 19 December

  • Street entertainers

  • Festive DJ

  • Performances from local dance groups

  • Extra indoor Christmas market with a variety of traders

Wakefield Christmas Market

Wood Street will become a festive Christmas market from 11 to 13 December. Browse Christmas gifts, decorations and festive products from a range of traders. You can also enjoy food and drink from local businesses.

Please note that Wood Street will be closed to traffic from 10 to 14 December.

Dates: 11 to 13 December

Times: Friday and Saturday: 10am - 6pm, Sunday: 10am - 5pm

Wakefield Council is working with Market Place to host this event. Local traders interested in taking part in the market can apply.

Memory Tree

The Memory Tree will be in Pontefract Market Hall. Visitors are invited to hang a message on the tree to remember loved ones who are no longer with us. It offers a quiet place to reflect during the festive season.

Date: 30 November to 24 December Location: Unit 27, Pontefract Market Hall

For more festive events, visit www.experiencewakefield.co.uk.
